title: Seoul police send 52 people to prosecutors over fake plastic-surgery reviews posted with hacked portal accounts
date_note: Date of the Financial News article reporting the Seoul police announcement; the page gives no earlier day.
geo_basis: Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency cyber investigation unit
summary: Financial News reports that Seoul police's cyber investigation unit sent 52 people to prosecutors, including staff of four plastic-surgery clinics, over fake reviews. Police say they bought 800 hijacked portal accounts from a Chinese hacking group and posted 8,400 posts and comments. Police say the group sold the accounts via Telegram from Qingdao.
plain: Seoul police say 52 people, including clinic and ad-agency staff, were sent to prosecutors over fake reviews posted using about 800 hijacked portal accounts.
exec: Police say clinics and ad firms bought hijacked accounts to post 8,400 fake reviews, which they say distorts patients' choice of clinic.

evidence.quote: 성형외과 4곳과 광고대행사 1곳, 직영 광고업체 2곳, 해킹조직 관계자 등 총 52명을 검거해 송치했다.
타인 명의 포털 계정 800여개를 구매해 허위 후기 광고에 활용한 혐의를 받는다.

validation.note: Only Financial News was read; hani.co.kr carries the story but could not be opened.
